demos.name: Agent Privilege Field Guide
demos.description: Guided tour of the five PingOne Privilege Agent Privilege console sections — Agent Registry, Agentic Apps, Federated Identity, Self-Hosted Agents, AI Platform Agents — plus the Identity/Grant/Guardrail/Discovery mental model, six diagram-studio diagrams and a Workforce-vs-CIAM map. Mock-only by design; untested deck claims are labelled UNVERIFIED.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7826). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: docker compose up -d --build (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock-only by design: no live engine, zero outbound calls in any mode; APG_MODE_REAL=1 only enables the rule-19 Real switch. Derived from the AI-DEMO2 field guide, rewritten customer-neutral.
